intro: Lakeside View is a BTO project in Jurong West near Yuan Ching Road and Kang Ching Road, listed by a third-party tracker as 1,016 flats from 2-room Flexi to 5-room. It is one of the larger BTO handovers around this time. Below: key facts, what owners usually change, a defects check and how to plan your Lakeside View renovation.
whatsapp_text: Hi Maison, I'm collecting keys at Lakeside View and would like to discuss the renovation.

sections.heading: What to know about Lakeside View
sections.text:
With more than a thousand flats handing over, the first weeks after keys are crowded. Owners who report defects quickly and have a permit-ready plan start works first. The rest wait for contractors, lifts and the Building Service Centre.

Homes near the lake and greenery suit a calm, natural look: light timber, soft colours and plenty of daylight. In larger flats there is room for a proper study and family storage; in 2-room Flexi flats, keep it simple, safe and easy to clean.

sections.heading: What owners usually change
bullets: Natural timber tones and light colours to suit the setting.
4- and 5-room: a study, full-height wardrobes and a family area.
2-room Flexi: compact storage and slip-resistant finishes.
Toilet upgrades with tiles overlaid on the existing ones (no hacking in the first 3 years).

timeline_note: Plan on about 8 to 12 weeks from keys to move-in for a full renovation. In a handover this size, start planning before keys.

faq.q: When can I collect keys at Lakeside View?
faq.a: Your HDB notification gives your date. A third-party tracker estimates completion in 2026, but HDB has not confirmed a project-wide date on the pages we checked.

faq.q: How long do I have to report defects?
faq.a: HDB says to report all defects within 30 days of key collection, before renovation starts. The Defects Liability Period runs for 1 year from key collection.

faq.q: Can I start renovation on a Saturday?
faq.a: General works are allowed Monday to Saturday, 9am to 6pm, but noisy works such as hacking are allowed only on weekdays, 9am to 5pm.
